_comment: Companion services the forge builds beside the devcontainer and the devpod root deploys next to the workspace. Validated by the forge against its closed schema (app/internal/services/services.cue): a typo here is a red pull request naming this file. Defaults are left out on purpose -- dockerfile, protocol, and resources' other half when only one is named -- so the services.json the forge publishes for a build visibly differs from this source: THAT file, with every default filled, is what an operator passes to the devpod root. THE SERVICE IS STILL CALLED `db': its name is the workspace's DB_HOST/DB_PORT pair, its Consul service, its host volume and its bastion target, and none of those are about which engine answers -- renaming it would move six roster files to say nothing new. SQL Server differs from the PostgreSQL seeds in three DECLARED ways: it runs as uid 10001 and must own its volume (volume_uid), it refuses to start under 2 GB (resources), and its health is proved by sqlcmd against the engine rather than by a readiness binary.
